messages:
samir: FYI I pushed BOA-5b qlora 4-bit to canary this morning and some clients report 'regen loops' where the model repeats sampling patterns and truncates answers. can reproduce on small sample set.
li: ugh. can you paste an example prompt+output?
samir: sure — prompt: `Summarize the patent text below in 2 sentences.` output (truncated): 
```
The invention relates to a device that manages thermal flow. The device uses novel fins and a fan. The device uses novel fins and a fan. The device uses novel fins and a fan. The device uses novel fins and a fan.
```
li: that looks like a sampling collapse — repetition at low diversity. what temperature/top_p was used in the canary config?
samir: the canary config used temp=0.7, top_p=0.9, typical_p unset. sampling library = our wrapped sampling with cached logits + V100 kernels.
taylor: any differences vs fp16 baseline? like does 4-bit quant change logit scale or softmax numerics?
samir: fp16 baseline doesn't show this. quantized qlora 4-bit on same checkpoint shows repeat in ~12% of eval prompts.
chen: can you run `python -m infra.eval.sample_check --model boa-5b-qlora-4bit --seed 42 --n 1000 --prompts sample_patents.json --record_logits` and upload the artifacts?
samir: running now. I'll attach results.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for boa-5b-qlora-4bit at 2026-03-20T08:05Z (id=canary-boa-26912).
maria: assigning triage: @li to investigate quant sampling behavior, @samir please collect logits + RNG seeds. also add a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-2895
li: initial quick checks: 1) reproduces deterministically with seed 42 2) logits near-decoding show a spiky distribution with a handful of tokens dominating after token 12 3) KV-cache alignment looks ok but there's a small drift in layernorm scale (0.98 vs 1.0) when comparing fp16 vs 4-bit.
chen: could be a quant scale mismatch in rotary / bias scaling. also check if we accidentally applied per-tensor scale vs per-channel for attention weights.
samir: interesting — our quant pipeline uses GPTQ-style group size 128 by default. I'll re-run with group 64 and per-channel stats.
li: also try disabling fused softmax kernel and fall back to reference softmax — report back if numerics change.
samir: tests done: group 64 reduces repeat rate from 12% -> 3%. disabling fused softmax also reduces it to ~1%.
maria: ok action items: 1) rollback canary to fp16 for production traffic until we confirm fixes (assigned to @taylor) 2) create a canary variant with group64+no-fused-softmax for further stress tests (assigned to @samir) 3) add unit test comparing per-token logits between fp16 and quant within epsilon for 50 held prompts (assigned to @li).
taylor: rolling back production canary now. deploy-bot: rollback initiated for canary-boa-26912 at 2026-03-20T08:27Z.
ops-bot: alert: 2% error increase observed in canary metrics prior to rollback — spike isolated to canary cluster.
chen: follow-up experiments: try calibrating activation clipping and rescaling layernorm after quantization; also re-evaluate QAT vs static quant.
li: I'll draft a short doc with recommended quant settings for BOA family: group=64, per-channel, softmax fallback toggle, ln-rescale patch. will post in #eng-ml.
samir: attaching sample artifacts: link to S3 logs + logits: s3://redwood-logs/boa/2691234567/logs.tar.gz (contains seed, raw_logits.csv, outputs.json)
maria: thank you team. keep updates here. once we confirm stable config, we'll roll a controlled canary with perf metrics and eval baseline. :thumbsup:
